table.name: downshift: kickdown decel threshold
table.description: gates an automatic deceleration kickdown — when the driver lifts off the throttle and the car decelerates hard enough, the TCU forces a downshift to the lowest allowed gear for engine braking (or to prep for re-acceleration).

table.name: downshift: limiter overrev aggression
table.description: controls how close to the rev limiter the TCU allows when selecting the minimum gear.
